chunks: And certainly the recompense of the life to come is better for those who believe and follow the right path.

key_terms.يَتَّقُونَ: They are God-conscious / They practice piety

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who believe and are God-conscious according to Surah Joseph?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Yusuf, this verse serves as a divine reassurance to the Prophet and the faithful, contrasting the transient worldly gains of the disbelievers with the superior, eternal reward of the Hereafter. Shia scholarship often interprets 'those who were God-conscious' (kânû ya'taqûn) in the past tense as highlighting the enduring, active state of taqwa that characterizes the true believers, linking spiritual vigilance directly to ultimate success.
